mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 1.0% for three consecutive months, it signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 1.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicate strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1.2 million units signal robust consumer demand and rising home equity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with HOUST > 1200.0 during late-cycle, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate trend over the prior 6 months indicates improving labor market conditions that support sustained consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE decline over 6 months, or Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO < 100.0 for 2 months, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Joint growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with HOUST growth > 0.5% and RSAFS growth > 0.3%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%), rising consumer prices signal persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03.
